findings.claim: 前五大客戶 2025 年淨營收約 69 億美元，占總淨營收 21%；失去任一客戶或其重要卡方案可能衝擊營收。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, the net revenue from these customers was approximately $6.9 billion, or 21%, of total net revenue. The loss of any of these customers or their significant card programs could adversely impact our revenue.

findings.claim: 2023–2025 年沒有任何單一客戶占淨營收超過 10%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 附註
findings.excerpt: Mastercard did not have any individual customer that generated greater than 10% of net revenue in 2025, 2024 or 2023.

findings.claim: 風險因子揭露營收集中於前五大客戶，失去其中任一家可能有重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: a significant portion of our revenue is concentrated among our five largest customers. Loss of business from any of our large customers could have a material adverse impact on our overall business and results of operations.

findings.claim: 2026 年 6 月發債文件載明 Mastercard 發行人評等為 Moody's Aa3／S&P A+，展望皆穩定；搜尋未見 2026 年評等調降。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR Form FWP（2026-06 債券定價）
findings.excerpt: Issuer Ratings*: Aa3 / A+ by Moody's / S&P (stable / stable)

note: 搜尋未找到前幾大客戶（發卡行）信用惡化、破產或 Mastercard 下調財測的來源；僅為查無，不代表不存在。前五大客戶未具名。
